_about: Новая волна врагов: id -> [вид, описание]. Вид: N (обычный, портрет 2:3), E (элита, квадрат), B (босс, квадрат), S (значок особенности на чёрном), C (карта 4:3).
biryuk: A biryuk, a huge lone wolf grown old and savage: a grizzled grey-black wolf standing hunched on all four legs, scarred muzzle, one ear torn away, hackles raised along the spine, bared yellow fangs, a broken hunter's snare rope still knotted around its neck.
podmenysh: A podmenysh, a changeling: a child-sized wizened creature wrapped in a stolen embroidered baby's swaddling cloth that hangs off it like a cape, the wrinkled face of a very old man with a wide sly toothless grin, long thin grey fingers hugging a stolen bundle to its chest, bare dirty feet.
polevik: A polevik, the spirit of the field: a short lean dark-skinned man whose hair and beard are dry rye stalks, one green eye and one yellow eye, a tattered white shirt belted with a twist of straw, bast shoes, a small rusted sickle held low in one hand, ears of rye stuck in his belt.
zhivoglot: A zhivoglot, a swallower: a squat bloated troll-like creature with a grotesquely huge round belly and a mouth so wide it splits the face from ear to ear, rows of flat stump teeth, tiny eyes, thin arms, the shapes of swallowed round wooden shields bulging under the skin of its stomach.
gravedigger: A dead gravedigger: a tall stooped corpse in a long earth-caked burial coat and a shapeless felt hat, a grey sunken face with a few long hairs, a heavy wooden spade with an iron edge held across the body, a lantern of horn hanging from the belt, grave dirt falling from the sleeves.
pugach: A pugach, an evil eagle-owl of folk tales: a huge ragged eagle-owl in flight, wings spread wide, long feathered ear tufts like horns, burning round orange eyes, hooked beak open in a hoot, long black talons reaching forward.
bolotnitsa: A bolotnitsa, a bog maiden: a gaunt pale woman with greenish skin rising from nothing, long black wet hair hanging to her knees threaded with duckweed and leeches, webbed goose feet instead of human feet, a sodden shift, a red stained mouth and sharp teeth, one clawed hand reaching out.
ancestor_shade: The shade of a forefather: a tall stern old ghost of a village elder in an old-fashioned long kaftan and a fur hat, a long white beard, the whole figure pale grey and half translucent with its edges dissolving into mist, empty dark eye sockets, one bony finger pointed in silent reproach.
nav_hound: A hound of Nav: a gaunt black hunting dog from the land of the dead, skin stretched over visible ribs and spine, bony skull-like head, pale white eyes, long snout sniffing low to the ground, torn ears, a rusted iron collar with a broken chain.
fire_serpent: The Fiery Serpent of folk tales, the seducer of widows: a long winged serpent coiling in the air, its body of dark red-black scales with molten orange cracks, a half-human handsome bearded face on the snake head with a charming smile, small bat wings, a forked tongue.
tugarin: Tugarin Zmeyevich, a monstrous steppe warlord: a towering broad man with a scaled snake-like face and slit yellow eyes, ornate dark lamellar armour and a pointed helm, huge wings made of oiled paper and thin hide stretched on wooden ribs spread behind his shoulders, a long curved sabre in one hand.
black_volhv: A black volhv, a dark pagan sorcerer: a tall gaunt old man in a ragged black hooded robe, a long white beard braided with small bones, a staff topped with a black goat skull, black runes cut into his bare forearms and painted on his face, wooden rune plaques hanging from his belt.
vedmak: A vedmak, a male witch mid-transformation: a broad bearded village sorcerer in a sheepskin coat turned inside out, his left half still a man with a cunning face and a knife, his right half already turning into a huge grey wolf with fur, claws and a lengthening fanged muzzle.
wolf_herder: The wolf herder, master of the forest wolves: a tall old man in a coat of grey wolf pelts with a wolf's head as a hood, a long shepherd's crook of black wood, a bone whistle on a cord around his neck, wild grey hair and beard, yellow wolf-like eyes.
spinner: The spinner, a monstrous spider-woman: the upper body of a gaunt old woman in a headscarf with eight black eyes on her face, joined to the bloated body of a giant spider with long hairy legs, her human hands spinning grey thread on an old wooden distaff, threads of silk trailing from her.
upyr_knyaz: The upyr prince, a vampire lord: a tall corpse-pale nobleman in a rich rotted red kaftan trimmed with sable and a tall boyar fur hat, a dark-stained beard and mouth, long yellow nails, a golden chain and rings on bony fingers, a cold arrogant face.
miller: The vodyanoy miller: a huge fat drowned man with grey-green wet skin and a long beard of waterweed, a flour-stained leather apron, carrying an enormous round millstone on his shoulder, water streaming from his clothes, a broken mill wheel paddle at his belt.
obderikha: An obderikha, the bathhouse hag who flays: a huge naked-looking shaggy old woman covered in matted wet hair, enormous long claws, a birch bath broom in one hand and a strip of torn hide in the other, steam-reddened skin, a wide toothy grin.
chernobog_priest: A priest of Chernobog: a tall man in a black hooded robe and a black wooden mask carved as a grim bearded god, a long curved sacrificial knife in one hand and a black bronze bowl in the other, a necklace of teeth, dark blood on his hands and sleeves.
alkonost: The Alkonost, the bird of sorrow and sleep: a great bird with the head and chest of a pale beautiful woman with closed sleepy eyes and a small crown, wings of dark blue and dusky violet feathers half folded, long golden talons, lips parted in a soft lullaby.
chernobog: Chernobog, the Black God of darkness: a colossal dark figure of a god in black iron armour and a black cloak, a huge grim bearded face of black stone with silver eyes, a black sun disc on a tall staff in one hand, a broken shackle on the other wrist, standing tall and towering.
zhlya: Zhlya, the goddess of mourning: a tall emaciated woman in a long grey funeral dress and a white headcloth, pale ash-grey face streaked with dark tears, her mouth open in a wailing lament, holding a clay pot of cold grey ashes, barefoot, long thin hands.
karna: Karna, the goddess of grief and funerals, sister of Zhlya: a tall gaunt woman in a black funeral dress with a black veil thrown back, a hard pale face with burning angry eyes, her hands bound in black funeral ribbons, holding a long iron funeral torch, barefoot.
lone: a lone grey wolf's head howling, seen in profile, on its own
changeling: an empty wooden cradle with a small bundle of swaddling cloth in it that has an old man's wrinkled face
furrow: a plough furrow cut across the ground with a single sickle stuck in it
paper_wings: a pair of bat-like wings made of old oiled paper stretched on thin wooden ribs
withering: a withered dead flower drooping over a cracked clay bowl
blood_scent: a black hound's nose sniffing at three drops of dark red blood
twin_soul: two pale female faces back to back, joined like a two-faced idol, one weeping and one angry
black_runes: a black stone tablet carved with three jagged runes, dark red in the grooves
eclipse: a black sun eclipse: a dark disc covering the sun with a thin cold ring of light around it
stolen: a small cloth bundle tied with string, a playing card corner sticking out of it, held by a thin grey hand
podkidysh: @A foundling: a small wizened changeling infant with an old man's face lying in a wooden cradle in a dark peasant hut, wrapped in stolen swaddling cloth, grinning slyly at the viewer.
silk: @Thick grey spider silk threads tangled in a dark doorway of a peasant hut, a huge web stretched across, dead moths caught in it, a wooden distaff lying on the floor below.
